baseline_bump_justification: 2026-06-12 i18n EN/FR sweep: web baseline raised 11662 -> 12375 (+713) and pos 40 -> 101 (+61) by introducing the WARN-level local/no-untranslated-literal rule. It surfaces pre-existing untranslated user-facing string literals (JSX text + placeholder/title/alt/aria-label/label attributes) that bypass react-i18next t(). These are burned down cluster-by-cluster per docs/i18n/i18n-tracker.yaml; the count may only shrink from here, and cleaned feature dirs are promoted to ERROR via eslint.config.js overrides so they cannot regress.
